scope: Timing-only two-round capacity interpretation; empirical estimates, not vendor-specification validation

capacity_estimates.evidence: 64 B huge-page random chains: round-2 32 KiB medians 4.625 and 4.71875; 36 KiB 11.6875; 40 KiB 12.09375 TSC ticks/load. Coarse 32 KiB was 4.40625.
64 B huge-page random chains: round-2 256 KiB medians 12.53125 and 12.75; 288 KiB 41.515625; 320 KiB 41.578125 TSC ticks/load.

Round-2 primary layout: 16 MiB 41.71875; 28 MiB 49.953125; 40 MiB 156.375; 52 MiB 194.9375; 64 MiB 202.1875 TSC ticks/load. Compact layout at 40 MiB gives 95.453125/97.484375, while base pages at 40 MiB give 181.5.
capacity_estimates.interpretation: Broad layout- and page-dependent effective transition; this interval does not bound nominal physical capacity.

caveats: The incomplete initial round1 attempt is preserved but excluded from both formal rounds.
The coarse 32 MiB point has block medians 89.890625-162.40625; all samples and tails are retained.

Measurement regions contain 138 involuntary context switches in total (at most 7 in one configuration), with no measured faults or voluntary switches; this does not rule out shared-machine or frequency effects.
Different layouts, page policies, batch lengths, and runs are kept separate. Consecutive timed batches are not independent experiment repetitions.
lscpu host inspection included cache specifications; the evidence and selected follow-up intervals come from new timing data, but this execution was not blind to hardware specifications.

third_round.assessment: The requested two-round procedure is complete. Optional narrower L1/L2 sampling could refine 32-36 KiB and 256-288 KiB if needed. Exact LLC capacity remains unresolved and no further LLC search was performed.
